title: Streamlit is written the way all software should be written.
body:
### Message

I can just import streamlit and do streamlit.write() and it does something.  Amazing.  I can set up a whole app in just a few lines.

There are many, many other libraries that take 40 to 50 lines to set up absolutely anything.  Some libraries take 2 whole pages just to set up a database.  I really appreciate the effort you guys have put into making everything simple for the user.

comments.body: Thank you so much, very appreciated! We forwarded this to the team :)
